rules: Unknown numerical values and unassessed warning flags are null, never zero or false.
A warning can coexist with missing geographic context; keep the original warning and scope the missingness.
The existing detector may itself abstain on missing geography; do not fabricate a geography-free score or silently change that policy.
Not-yet-observed events do not establish missing source records, cancellation or a completed stage.
Preserve slow-stage warnings on early deliveries; do not force a faster stage when none is supported.
Promise-date basis remains unverified; before visibility is established, calendar lateness is retrospective only.
Original detector output is immutable to agents. Later source corrections create a new version with a reason and retained history.
Explain data-supported concentration, not guilt, fraud or verified operational cause.
Record detector readiness, agent completion and display times separately. Replay event time is not measured network ingestion time.

agents.goal: Locate the measured stage deviation and its evidence.
Check alternative observed explanations before presenting geographic hypotheses.
Check references, temporal eligibility and overclaiming; request bounded revisions.

geographic_investigation.claim_wording: Dau hieu cham tap trung o nhom dia ly sau khi doi chieu cac yeu to co du lieu; can kiem tra them.
geographic_investigation.approval: Do not attribute approval duration to physical delivery distance. Payment context is retrospective unless availability is established.
geographic_investigation.preparation_handoff: Examine product, item count, seller attribution and stage-start period; destination association alone is not a delivery-distance mechanism.
geographic_investigation.transport: Examine product or declared category fallback, item count, seller/origin, stage-start period and geography quality. Weight, dimensions and service level need audited availability before use.
rules: Group membership is not group-level evidence and association is not causation.
Fix comparison plans before inspecting favorable results. Preserve null/negative findings and all attempted comparisons.
Use the same stage and comparable observation windows. Exclude target orders from comparators.
Control only appropriate pre-stage or demonstrably available context; do not match on the outcome duration, delay score, final status, later reviews or future milestones.

When comparing customer regions, control observed distance bands if testing differences beyond distance. When testing distance, do not also match exactly on distance; define a separate estimand and non-geographic controls.
Do not rank long-distance routes by raw elapsed time as if distance itself proved a problem.
Previously conditioned detector flags describe residual contextual warnings; they do not estimate the total effect of geography.
No data-driven widening of peer groups merely to obtain a positive result. Report inadequate overlap and missing fields.
Do not assign a multi-seller order's shared order-level milestone to an individual seller without supporting attribution.
Existing matched-support cutoffs are reporting guards, not calibrated probabilities or guarantees of significance.
Historical aggregate evidence must end before the assessed event for replay; final validation-month or holdout aggregates are retrospective only.
Exploratory repeated comparisons need multiplicity and temporal stability checks before stronger claims.
Static Olist context has unverified arrival history; keep verified-only and explicit-assumption scenarios separate.
geographic_investigation.legacy_context_output: Limited retrospective comparisons; not evidence that all listed controls were applied.

evaluation.sampling: Deterministic stratified selection of real development cases including warnings, nonwarnings and unavailable or conflicting cases; retain protected IDs; record reuse and exposure.
evaluation.human_review: User reviews explanations against evidence; does not create confirmed bottleneck ground truth by repeating detector flags.
evaluation.cache: Reuse explicitly marked results in demos; fresh runs for repeatability tests. Cached replay is not live agent latency.
evaluation.auc: Unchanged detector scores imply unchanged detector AUC; explainability gains are measured separately.
evaluation.test_use: Do not tune on previously exposed holdout or present it as fresh independent evidence.
